before_record.title: Adopt scoped premise flows through an explicitly checked production semantic consumer
before_record.why: PREMISE-FLOW-OPERATORS supplies executable AND/OR/positive-NOT/terminal syntax and proposed composition, exact source/model/graph/Context replay and independently checked finite source-witness integrations. It deliberately migrates no production flow clause, registers no global typed predicate and supplies no verdict/standing consumer. Missing capability: turn one exactly scoped production obligation into checked authority only under independently discharged complete antecedents, without treating a generic ProposedEvaluation or a finite fixture as universal source truth. DISCHARGE: select and freeze a bounded production declaration/property and eligible predicate family; establish exact source/model/prose/environment correspondence and complete scoped evidence, including every feasible program-path obligation; implement a total-or-reject checked consumer and dependency/invalidation rule with matching Rust/Lean, exact9-coordinate context and refutation controls; preserve legacy erasure/classification and validate intentional verdict movement through standing/provider/all-route evidence. Safe requires all relevant obligations; Unsafe still requires a validated reachable C violation. Existing CJSON-REPRESENTATION-PROSE-AND-SOURCE-BINDING, LIBC-READING-PREMISES-TYPED-DISCHARGE, PLUGIN-PREMISE-SOURCE-BINDING and PLUGIN-PREMISE-OUTER-TRUTH retain their independent source/prose/world proof scopes.

after_record.title: Adopt scoped premise flows through an explicitly checked production semantic consumer
after_record.why: PREMISE-FLOW-OPERATORS supplies executable AND/OR/positive-NOT/terminal syntax and proposed composition, exact source/model/graph/Context replay and independently checked finite source-witness integrations. PREMISE-SYMBOLIC-ADOPTION adds 169 proposed production conjunction flows and 1,179 symbolic hypothesis introductions in eight provider contract files, preserving all original hypotheses, premise groups, graphs, binding manifests and interpreted clauses. These are proposed metadata: no global typed predicate, checked semantic/lifecycle consumer, verdict or standing authority is supplied. Missing capability: turn one exactly scoped production obligation into checked authority only under independently discharged complete antecedents, without treating a generic ProposedEvaluation or a finite fixture as universal source truth. DISCHARGE: select and freeze a bounded production declaration/property and eligible predicate family; establish exact source/model/prose/environment correspondence and complete scoped evidence, including every feasible program-path obligation; implement a total-or-reject checked consumer and dependency/invalidation rule with matching Rust/Lean, exact9-coordinate context and refutation controls; preserve legacy erasure/classification and validate intentional verdict movement through standing/provider/all-route evidence. Safe requires all relevant obligations; Unsafe still requires a validated reachable C violation. Existing CJSON-REPRESENTATION-PROSE-AND-SOURCE-BINDING, LIBC-READING-PREMISES-TYPED-DISCHARGE, PLUGIN-PREMISE-SOURCE-BINDING and PLUGIN-PREMISE-OUTER-TRUTH retain their independent source/prose/world proof scopes. Checked lifecycle lowering additionally requires independently bound fresh allocation identities, source-bound creation/release events, ownership and alias effects, lifetime and linear-use judgments, and versioned hypothesis retirement with complete dependent invalidation. Symbolic |^+ and |^- records alone prove none of those effects; a failed proof or retirement alone never proves negation or a reachable violation. The active production hypotheses remain unretired and Open.
